entities.summary: Norican Kingdom, a political institution in Slovenia during Prehistoric & Roman Emona (3500 BCE–200 BCE). Led to the emergence of Ljubljana Marshes wooden wheel crafted – oldest in the world and Roman Emona & Poetovio.
